newsitem.title: USA: LME cash zine price to reach $1400 a tonne - CRU.
newsitem.headline: LME cash zine price to reach $1400 a tonne - CRU.

text.p: The zinc supply/demand balance will remain in deficit for at least two years, and with stocks declining, the LME cash zinc price could reach 65 cents a pound within a year, Geoff Mason, analyst with CRU International told an industry meeting.

"I will be disappointed if LME cash has not hit $1400 per tonne by the end of next year's (American Zinc Association) meeting, but $1600 a tonne may to have wait until later in (1998)," Mason told the annual meeting of the American Zinc Association.
Mason suggested there could well be sprice spikes up to $2000 per tonne.
